attempts.summary: FB_CraneSpeedCheck validates the three INT inputs against 0..100 with ReferenceSpeed10>0 before any arithmetic, promotes to DINT for the difference and 13*reference computations, and independently recomputes all three outputs each scan so exactly one of SyncOK/SyncBad/Invalid is TRUE.
Replaced the unsupported DINT#(...) cast literals with standard INT_TO_DINT conversions, keeping range validation before any arithmetic and independent recomputation of the three outputs each scan.

Renamed the local variable `Ref` (reserved word in STruC++ 0.7) and other potentially conflicting locals to safe identifiers, keeping identical logic: range-validate all three INTs (0..100, ReferenceSpeed10>0) before any arithmetic, promote to DINT for ABS(Left-Right)<=1 and ABS(Left+Right-13*Reference)<=2, and recompute all three outputs from scratch each scan so exactly one of SyncOK/SyncBad/Invalid is TRUE.
